newsitem.title: UK: Migrogen Holdings down on profits warning.
newsitem.headline: Migrogen Holdings down on profits warning.

text.p: Shares in British computer services group Microgen Holdings fell on Wednesday after the company issued a profits warning with its interim results.
The stock was 33-1/2p lower at 115p by 755 GMT.

"The likely outcome is that, even though our newer businesses are growing well and are enhanced by the acquisition of TBS (Transactional Business Services), our full-year profits will be significantly below earlier expectations and those of last year," chairman Douglas Lee said in a statement.
Microgen posted pre-tax profits of 4.2 million stg for the six months ended April 30, down from 4.9 million previously.
